note: Metcalfe County (KY) parcels are only published through the Schneider qPublic / qPublic.net PVA viewer, a proprietary web application with no public ArcGIS REST or WFS/OGC service found. ArcGIS Hub and Online searches for Metcalfe parcels returned no county parcel service (only a BRADD precinct layer, a KYTC PVA-availability layer that is not parcels, and a Regrid nationwide aggregator with no confirmed queryable Metcalfe parcels). Remaining parcel sources are paid vendor shapefiles, not a public service.
